title: inferring
description: Morphism: context -> inference. Claude Code's root action morphism, a degenerate articulating generator in the aperiodic regime (kappa >= omega_1). It unfolds a context (session state + latest input) into one session-unfold step: a message plus embedded next-actions. The enactor (an LLM endpoint; for the conductor seat, the Opus model running this session) is fungible and supplied externally -- inferring is the morphism, the endpoint is merely what fires it.
